verses.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਦੀ ਕਿਉ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: abigat gat abigat dhee kiau alakh lakhaae|

en.bdb: How is the dynamism of the Unmanifest known?

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਅਕਥ ਦੀ ਕਿਉ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: akath kathaa hai akath dhee kiau aakh sunaae|

en.bdb: How can the story of that ineffable Lord be told?

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜ ਨੋ ਆਚਰਜੁ ਹੈ ਹੈਰਾਣ ਕਰਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: acharaj no aacharaj hai hairaan karaae|

en.bdb: He is wonderful for the wonder itself.
The absorbents in the wondrous realization get themselves elated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਦੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਸੇਸਨਾਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: vedh na jaanai bhedh kih sesanaag na paae|

en.bdb: The Vedas also do not understand this mystery and even the Sesanag (mythological snake having thousand hoods) cannot know its limits.
Vahiguru, God, is eulogised through recitation of the Word of the Guru, Gurbani.
